MYSQL_DATABASE.description: Mysql database for mysql. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

MYSQL_USER.description: Mysql user for mysql. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

MYSQL_PASSWORD.description: Generated mysql password. Keep private and preserve with backups.

MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD.description: Generated mysql root password. Keep private and preserve with backups.

PORT.description: HTTP port inside this service. Keep the default to match its Railway public port and health check.

SECRET_KEY.description: Generated secret key. Keep private and preserve with backups.

ADMIN_EMAIL.description: Required administrator email for first startup.

ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Generated admin password. Keep private and preserve with backups.

CREATE_SUPERUSER.description: Create superuser resolved automatically from the linked service. Keep this reference when using the included topology.

DATABASE_URL.description: Private PostgreSQL connection URL assembled from generated credentials and service references. No manual value is needed.

BASE_URL.description: Base url resolved automatically from the linked service. Keep this reference when using the included topology.
